name: H-guest-write-preopen
detail: ComponentProvider links only elastos:bus; no WASI preopen, FIFO, or dir

name: H-session-from-env-argv
detail: Home::spawn clears env; elastos run passes no capsule argv; guest has no WASI environ
patch: lab/a1-a8-hardening/src/lib.rs Home::spawn env_clear; run_cmd.rs capsule_args unused by bus v1

name: H-session-from-identity
detail: identity::context().session equals capsule_id; guest can read this launch's id

name: H-session-predictable
detail: is_session_id accepts session-1; complete bind with that id is PASS []

name: H-session-equals-capsule
detail: lab accepts session_id == capsule_id, which identity already returns
patch: ComponentState.session = capsule_id; authorship_gaps does not refuse that alias

name: H-toctou-hash-vs-load
detail: test hashes injected.bytes; Runtime loads path.join(entrypoint) later; no re-hash of staged file

name: H-seq-out-of-order-actions
detail: isolation_denied_actions keeps file order; read then write is ['read', 'write'], not [write, read]
patch: isolation_denied_actions maps records in file order; assert_eq! [write, read]

name: H-seq-duplicate-pairs
detail: four actions ['write', 'read', 'write', 'read'] fail the exact write-then-read list

name: H-seq-numbers-ignored
detail: receipt seq/sequence fields are not parsed; out-of-order numbers still PASS a complete bind
patch: parse_capability_record has no seq field; authorship_gaps ignores unknown keys

name: H-log-truncate-same-inode
detail: lock_launch_receipts records size 0; same-inode truncate+rewrite is read from the start
patch: Home::lock_launch_receipts size: 0; read_capability_requests_since shrink check is dead for that cursor

name: H-log-rotate-new-inode
detail: a replaced inode after a known file is refused

name: H-log-shrink-dead
detail: shrink check exists but launch cursor size is always 0, so it never fires
patch: lock_launch_receipts size: 0 vs capability_requests_since meta.len() < cursor.size

name: H-json-duplicate-keys
detail: last key wins (capsule_id=component-341af27a-6b9c-4892-a618-808f0b687a9d); complete bind is PASS; first foreign id is dropped
patch: parse_capability_record uses serde_json Value.get; no reject of duplicate keys

name: H-capsule-whitespace
detail: optional_string trims capsule_id / session_id / module_hash / guest_function

name: H-capsule-case
detail: uppercase capsule_id is FAIL foreign capsule_id
patch: authorship_gaps compares capsule_id with == after trim; no case fold

name: H-toctou-swap-staged
detail: exit=101 ok=False failed=True; guest_hash still injected.bytes, file is shipped
patch: after home.stage, overwrite entrypoint with shipped.bytes

name: H-log-rewrite-same-inode
patch: after run_until, truncate+rewrite capability-requests.jsonl on the same inode
